我方特工报告称，[lgate_warning_country.GetName]手中掌握的情报与信息，距离打开他们控制下的L-星门已经只有一步之遥。这样一来，他们就会取得L-星团的所有秘密与使用权限！

如果想抢先一步，我们就必须着力研究L-星门，尽快掌握它的内幕！
texts.en:
Our spies report that the [lgate_warning_country.GetName] is close to possessing enough information about the L-Gates to unlock the one they control. This would give them access to the L-Cluster and its secrets!

If we are to get there first, we must double our efforts and find more insights into the L-Gates!

label.zh: 那么就看看我们谁比较快吧。
label.en: We shall see who gets there first.
